steps.title: Prepare Bead Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare bead tubes and lysis buffers based on the kit used.

substeps.instruction: For standard processing: Add 320 µL of 1x PBS and 80 µL ATL-DX Buffer to the bead tubes.
For MagMAX Microbiome Ultra Nucleic Acid Isolation Kit: Add 800 µL of Lysis Buffer to clear RINO 1.5 mL tubes.

steps.title: Add Soil Samples
steps.instruction: Add soil samples to the prepared bead tubes.

substeps.instruction: Thaw frozen soil and keep on ice.
Use a clean spatula or forceps to weigh approximately 0.25 g of soil sample into each prepared bead tube.
Record the weight.

steps.title: Prepare Controls
steps.instruction: Include positive and negative controls for each batch.

substeps.instruction: Positive Control: Transfer 37.5 µL ZymoBIOMICS Microbial Community Standard Material, µL EBV, and 100 µL DENV-1 standard into a bead tube; add 162.5 µL 1xPBS.
Negative Control: Use a bead tube with 320 µL cold sterile 1xPBS only.

steps.title: Bead Beating and Lysis
steps.instruction: Perform mechanical lysis using the Bullet Blender.

substeps.instruction: Add dry ice into the cooling compartment of the Bullet Blender.
Load all bead tubes (samples and controls).
Set speed to 12 and time to 3; press Start.
Let samples settle for 00:01:00, then repeat the beating step.
Centrifuge tubes with lysate at 12,000 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Instrument Setup
steps.instruction: Configure the KingFisher instrument and load the required program.

substeps.instruction: For KingFisher Flex: Ensure program IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Flex_4wash (or MagMax_Microbiome_Soil_Flex for MagMAX kit) is loaded.

For KingFisher Duo Prime: Ensure program IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Duo_4wash (or MagMAX_Microbiome_Soil_Duo for MagMAX kit) is loaded; confirm 12-tip magnetic heads and 12-well deep-well heat blocks are used.

steps.title: Prepare Reagent Plates
steps.instruction: Set up Wash, Elution, and Tip Comb plates. Do NOT use the kit-provided elution buffer for TNA elution as it inhibits sequencing.

substeps.instruction: For KingFisher Flex (Deep-well plates):
- Elution: 75 µL Nuclease-free water
- Wash 4: 750 µL 100% ethanol
- Wash 3: 750 µL 80% ethanol
- Wash 2: 700 µL Buffer AW2
- Wash 1: 700 µL Buffer AW1
- Sample: 990 µL Lysate and lysis buffer
- Tip comb: 96 Deep-well Tip comb
For KingFisher Duo Prime (Sample Plate rows):
- Row A: 985 µL Lysate and lysis buffer
- Row B: 700 µL Buffer AW1
- Row C: 700 µL Buffer AW2
- Row D: 750 µL 80% ethanol
- Row E: 750 µL 100% ethanol
- Row F: Tip comb
For KingFisher Duo Prime (Elution Strip):
- Row A: 75 µL Nuclease-free water

steps.title: Proteinase K Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat the lysate with Proteinase K in a new deep-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL Proteinase K to each well (or 40 µL if using MagMAX Microbiome Ultra Nucleic Acid Isolation Kit).
Transfer 270 µL of supernatant (without particle carryover) to the Proteinase K wells (or up to 500 µL if using MagMAX kit). This is now the Sample Plate.

steps.title: Add Lysis Master Mix
steps.instruction: Add the lysis mixture to the Sample Plate (Optional for MagMAX kit).

substeps.instruction: Prepare a master mix (with 10% overage) containing 135 µL Buffer VXL, 540 µL Buffer ACB, and 20 µL MagAttract Suspension G per sample.
Invert slowly to mix (or use Hula mixer for 2 min); avoid foaming.
Add 695 µL of the mixture to each sample.
Select the appropriate program (IndiMag_Pathogen or MagMAX_Microbiome) based on the instrument and kit.
Start the run and load prepared plates when prompted.
For Duo Prime: Keep the door open during extraction to prevent ethanol vapor contamination.

steps.title: Prepare Binding Bead Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the magnetic bead binding mixture while the instrument is running.

substeps.instruction: Vortex magnetic beads vigorously.
For each sample, transfer 20 µL beads to 500 µL Binding Buffer (prepare master mix with 10% overage for multiple samples).
Mix by inverting and place on a rocker until use; do not vortex.

steps.title: Binding Bead Addition
steps.instruction: Add binding beads to the samples during the run.

substeps.instruction: Approximately 20 minutes after start, remove the Sample plate from the instrument when prompted.
Invert the Binding Bead mix and add 520 µL to each sample in the Sample Plate.
Remix frequently to ensure even bead distribution.
Place the Sample Plate back onto the instrument and resume the run.

steps.title: Elution and Storage
steps.instruction: Collect the final eluate and store the samples.

substeps.instruction: Once the protocol completes (~35 minutes), immediately remove the elution plate.
Cover the plate or transfer eluate to final storage tubes.
Store at -20 °C for < 2 weeks, or -80 °C for long-term storage following REDI-NET SOP S-3.

steps.title: Nucleic Acid Quantification
steps.instruction: Measure DNA and RNA concentrations using a Qubit 4 Fluorometer.

substeps.instruction: DNA Quantification: Mix 3 µL sample with 197 µL 1x HS dsDNA Qubit Assay. Vortex 5-10 seconds, incubate 2 minutes at room temperature, and read.

RNA Quantification: Prepare working solution (199 µL Qubit RNA HS Assay buffer + 1 µL Dye). Mix 3 µL sample with 197 µL of this working solution in a 0.6 mL tube. Vortex 5-10 seconds, incubate 2 minutes at room temperature, and read.
